subject: mathematics
concept: Finding the area of composite figures made from rectangles
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student splits a virtual composite shape into rectangles and finds each area
exercise.pictorial: Student draws a dividing line on a pictured composite figure to split it into rectangles
exercise.abstract: Student calculates total area of a composite figure by summing rectangle parts

misconception_flags: double-counts an overlapping region or omits a section of the composite shape

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
